title: Cross-game memory file
description: One role's cross-game memory after one game, written by the program (src/dont_say_oyster/memory.py) as <role>-<nn>.json and read by the next game. Fields: SPEC.md, Architecture, Cross-game memory definition (Storage, the size limit). Every object lists every one of its fields as required and allows no other.

game.description: The game after which the file was written; the file name carries the same number.

entries.description: The latest entries in full, in ascending game order, at most five (the size limit). Not necessarily contiguous: a game whose entry the Check rule refused leaves none.

summary.description: The rolling summary of the older entries; null until there is one.
